table.name: TLGNR_ARCHIVING_STATUS_BS
table.description: Reference table for the different types of order archiving status.

column.name: ARCHIVING_STATUS_CD
column.description: PK. Status of the order archiving. 1=new, 2=archiving failed, 3=deletable, etc.

column.name: DISPLAY_FLAG
column.description: When this is false then the order is not visible. Please do NOT use for business decisions, this is only for the decision about displaying or hiding the order.
